name: immich-auto-describe
title: Auto Describe (AI captions)
description: Generate AI visual descriptions and tags for photos and videos using a local or cloud vision model, via the auto-describe sidecar.
author: jeroentrappers

templates.name: auto-describe-new-uploads
templates.title: Auto-describe new uploads
templates.description: When a photo or video is uploaded, generate an AI description + tags (skips assets that already have a description).

methods.name: describe
methods.title: Generate AI description
methods.description: Send the asset to the description sidecar (local/cloud VLM) and store the returned caption + tags.

sidecarUrl.title: Sidecar URL
sidecarUrl.description: Base URL of the auto-describe sidecar service

language.title: Output language
language.description: Language for the generated description (e.g. en, nl, de)

overwriteExisting.title: Overwrite existing
overwriteExisting.description: Replace a description even if one already exists (never overwrites manual edits unless enabled)
